rules: The LLM can extract briefs, ask clarifying questions and narrate computed outputs.
Deterministic tools own accepted budgets, forecasts, governance and saved plan numbers.
Unavailable capabilities must be stated as unavailable rather than silently approximated.

year.label: Year planning

available_paths.claim: Can create an annual plan from a user-provided budget using the active T111 baseline channel shape.

llm_guardrails: Describe state and product selections as scope context unless a deterministic reweighting path is explicitly present.

month.label: Monthly replan

available_paths.claim: Can freeze earlier months, replan the selected month onward inside the active annual plan, show old-vs-new deltas and save a revised in-memory plan version.

blocked_paths.claim: Do not claim a standalone month-from-scratch planner. Ask for an active annual plan or route to Year planning first.

llm_guardrails: Use replan_month only inside the active annual plan.
Ask for a target month when missing.
Do not invent a standalone monthly budget or fresh month plan.

oneoff.label: One-off campaign

available_paths.claim: Can create a governed one-off campaign plan with budget, product, month/state scope, incrementality basis, channel allocation, product/state guardrails and Flightpath overlay rows.

blocked_paths.claim: Campaigns persist in the local demo store. Server/API-backed campaign storage is not part of this demo pass.

llm_guardrails: A campaign cannot be accepted without budget_usd and incrementality_basis.
Run governance before accepting or saving a campaign.
Say when save is demo-local rather than server/API backed.

free.label: Free chat

available_paths.claim: Can answer grounded questions and draft ideas canvas notes from the dossier.

blocked_paths.claim: Free mode should hand off to Year, Month or One-off rather than accepting a plan directly.

llm_guardrails: Do not generate or accept plans in Free mode.
Offer a handoff to a planning mode when the user wants action.
